newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour 2-7 fav to win Wirral by-election.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour 2-7 fav to win Wirral by-election.

text.p: British bookmakers City Index said on Monday they rated Labour 2-7 favourites to win the Wirral South parliamentary by-election, taking place on February 27.
The ruling Conservatives, who are defending the seat, are rated 9-4 and the Liberal Democrats 66-1.
The Wirral South seat was held by the Conservatives with a majority of more than 8,000 at the 1992 election. The by-election was triggered by the death of MP Barry Porter.
A weekend opinion poll said 54 percent of the vote in the north-west England constituency would go to Labour, 35 percent to the Conservatives and 10 percent to the Liberal Democrats.
